name: whowrote
description: Tell human, bot and AI-agent commits and pull requests apart, from the signals they disclose: Co-authored-by trailers, agent accounts, session links. A sourced registry of AI coding tools and bots, a zero-dependency library and a CLI that breaks down a repository's history.
author: Daniel Eremeev (https://danieleremeev.dev)

scripts.build: node scripts/registry.mjs --check && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/registry.mjs --json dist/registry.json && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755)"
